annotation.title_clean: Komisia uverejňuje usmernenia k vymedzeniu systému umelej inteligencie s cieľom uľahčiť uplatňovanie pravidiel prvého aktu o umelej inteligencii
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on AI system definition to facilitate application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page (Slovak version) announcing non-binding guidelines on the definition of an AI system under the EU AI Act, published 6 February 2025 alongside guidelines on prohibited practices. It links to the guidelines in all EU languages and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines help providers determine whether a software system is an AI system under the AI Act.
The guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time based on practical experience.
Published alongside the guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules, including AI system definition, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025.
AI Act classifies systems into prohibited, high-risk and transparency-obligation categories.
